content: {"reasoning":"The claim was already submitted clean 16 days ago and no payer response is on the table; it is still pending well within the 90-day timely filing window. No prior auth is required, so the missing auth is irrelevant, and resubmitting (submit_clean or correct_and_resubmit) would risk a CO-18 duplicate denial. There is no denial to appeal, no CO-16 info request, and billing patient/secondary or writing off is premature before primary adjudication. No available action can properly progress a claim that simply needs adjudication time.","action":"escalate"}
